WITH customer_order_count AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.gender,
    COUNT(o.order_id) as num_orders
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender
),
gender_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    gender,
    SUM(num_orders) as gender_total
  FROM customer_order_count
  GROUP BY gender
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    coc.customer_id,
    coc.gender,
    coc.num_orders,
    CAST(coc.num_orders AS FLOAT) / gt.gender_total as share
  FROM customer_order_count coc
  JOIN gender_totals gt ON coc.gender = gt.gender
),
avg_share_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  s.customer_id,
  s.gender,
  s.num_orders,
  s.share,
  s.share - asv.avg_share as gap_above_average
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share_value asv
WHERE s.share > asv.avg_share
ORDER BY gap_above_average DESC NULLS LAST, s.customer_id
LIMIT 10
